ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=a3f9c21 introduced a refactored HTTP/3 stream scheduler (network/http3/scheduler.go) that failed to handle the QUIC connection-level BLOCKED flow control state. When a specific code path caused the connection-level send window to reach zero, acquire_send_slot() entered an infinite wait while holding the stream_mux lock. This caused all subsequent HTTP/3 stream goroutines to pile up waiting for the same lock, deadlocking the entire network stack and making the frontend service completely unresponsive to all web content requests.
ground_truth_remediation: Set the feature flag DISABLE_HTTP3=true to immediately force the frontend service to fall back to HTTP/2, bypassing the deadlocked QUIC transport. Clear the alt-svc cache so clients stop advertising HTTP/3 for affected hosts. This restores service within minutes. Follow up by reverting sha=a3f9c21 and sha=b9d4e55 from the main branch and fixing the BLOCKED state handling in h3_stream_scheduler.acquire_send_slot() before re-enabling HTTP/3.
